## 2024-05-24 — Unredacted PII in AuditTrail Logs
**Data traced:** PII (Emails, Phone Numbers, SSNs, Credit Cards)
**Exposure found:** `AuditTrail` logs (specifically in `action` and `details` fields) generated by `createAuditLog` in `src/utils/audit.ts`
**Fix:** Introduced a robust `redactPII` function in `src/utils/audit.ts` to automatically mask emails, phone numbers, SSNs, and credit cards before they are hashed and stored in the logs.
**Coverage confirmed:** Tested the `createAuditLog` to ensure that sensitive fields are completely masked in the logged text while maintaining contextual usefulness (e.g. `j***@example.com`). Hashes are computed on the redacted text, preserving structural validation.
**Still exposed elsewhere:** Currently only covering `AuditTrail`. Need to verify other layers if new logging services are added.
